title: The Target Agent Is Its Own Best Critic but a Poor Proposer: Self-Improved Red Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2610.34965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic red teaming increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs) to iteratively diagnose failed attacks and propose improved adversarial prompts or injections. Although prior work strengthens this loop through prompt engineering and search-harness design, the mechanisms underlying its two core roles, criticism and attack proposal, has not been explored. To further investigate the core roles and therefore improve red teaming effectiveness, we disentangle two design choices: whether criticism is generated by the target session itself (self-criticism) or by a separately instantiated critic (external criticism), and whether that criticism is translated into the next attack by the target session (self-proposal) or by a separate attacker (external proposal). translated_title: 目标智能体是自己最好的批评者，却是糟糕的提议者：自我改进的红队测试
translated_abstract: 自动红队测试日益依赖大语言模型（LLM）来迭代地诊断失败的攻击，并提出改进的对抗性提示或注入。尽管先前的工作通过提示工程和搜索框架设计强化了这一循环，但其两个核心角色——批评与攻击提议——背后的机制尚未被探索。为了进一步研究这些核心角色并提升红队测试的有效性，我们解耦了两个设计选择：批评是由目标会话自身生成（自我批评）还是由单独实例化的批评者生成（外部批评），以及该批评是由目标会话本身转化为下一次攻击（自我提议）还是由单独的攻击者完成（外部提议）。通过我们的分析，我们发现自我批评更为有效，因为它植根于目标的实时执行上下文，包括观察、约束和可……
tldr: 本研究首次解耦并探究了自动红队测试中批评与攻击提议这两个核心角色的机制，发现目标智能体基于自身实时执行上下文进行自我批评最有效，但攻击提议交由独立攻击者执行（外部提议）效果更好。
en_tdlr: This work disentangles and investigates the two core roles in automatic red teaming—criticism and attack proposal—showing that the target agent's self-criticism, grounded in its live execution context, is most effective, while attack proposal is best handled by a separate external attacker rather than the target itself.
